name: nexovanta-monorepo
description: QLLEX Technologies — Premium IT Services & Software Engineering Platform

scripts.build:api: npm --workspace=@nexovanta/shared run build && npm --workspace=@nexovanta/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@nexovanta/shared run build && npm --workspace=@nexovanta/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@nexovanta/api run build && npm --workspace=@nexovanta/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@nexovanta/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@nexovanta/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@nexovanta/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:verify && npm run test:browser
